Confidence intervals for
semipartial correlation coefficients
are generated using
the `SCorMC()` function from the `betaMC` package.
In this example,
we use the data set and the model used in
[betaMC: Example Using the BetaMC Function](example-beta-mc.html).


``` r
library(betaMC)
```




``` r
df <- betaMC::nas1982
```

### Regression

Fit the regression model using the `lm()` function.


``` r
object <- lm(QUALITY ~ NARTIC + PCTGRT + PCTSUPP, data = df)
```

### Monte Carlo Sampling Distribution of Parameters

#### Normal-Theory Approach


``` r
mvn <- MC(object, type = "mvn")
```

#### Asymptotic distribution-free Approach


``` r
adf <- MC(object, type = "adf")
```

#### Heteroskedasticity Consistent Approach (HC3)


``` r
hc3 <- MC(object, type = "hc3")
```

### Semipartial Correlation Coefficients

#### Normal-Theory Approach


``` r
mvn <- SCorMC(mvn)
```

#### Asymptotic distribution-free Approach


``` r
adf <- SCorMC(adf)
```

#### Heteroskedasticity Consistent Approach (HC3)


``` r
hc3 <- SCorMC(hc3)
```

## Methods

### summary

Summary of the results of `SCorMC()`.


``` r
summary(mvn)
#> Call:
#> SCorMC(object = mvn)
#> 
#> Semipartial correlations
#> type = "mvn"
#>            est     se     R  0.05%   0.5%   2.5%  97.5%  99.5% 99.95%
#> NARTIC  0.4312 0.0771 20000 0.1799 0.2274 0.2720 0.5729 0.6276 0.6892
#> PCTGRT  0.3430 0.0737 20000 0.1160 0.1550 0.1914 0.4814 0.5323 0.5825
#> PCTSUPP 0.2385 0.0697 20000 0.0280 0.0673 0.1026 0.3783 0.4295 0.5066
summary(adf)
#> Call:
#> SCorMC(object = adf)
#> 
#> Semipartial correlations
#> type = "adf"
#>            est     se     R   0.05%   0.5%   2.5%  97.5%  99.5% 99.95%
#> NARTIC  0.4312 0.0706 20000  0.0951 0.2149 0.2705 0.5471 0.5943 0.6472
#> PCTGRT  0.3430 0.0707 20000  0.0770 0.1443 0.1927 0.4680 0.5151 0.5744
#> PCTSUPP 0.2385 0.0696 20000 -0.0001 0.0486 0.0950 0.3681 0.4176 0.4700
summary(hc3)
#> Call:
#> SCorMC(object = hc3)
#> 
#> Semipartial correlations
#> type = "hc3"
#>            est     se     R   0.05%   0.5%   2.5%  97.5%  99.5% 99.95%
#> NARTIC  0.4312 0.0863 20000  0.0608 0.1392 0.2250 0.5678 0.6145 0.6649
#> PCTGRT  0.3430 0.0828 20000  0.0515 0.1072 0.1598 0.4869 0.5392 0.6057
#> PCTSUPP 0.2385 0.0793 20000 -0.0277 0.0238 0.0762 0.3880 0.4451 0.5182
```

### coef

Return the vector of estimates.


``` r
coef(mvn)
#>    NARTIC    PCTGRT   PCTSUPP 
#> 0.4311525 0.3430075 0.2384789
coef(adf)
#>    NARTIC    PCTGRT   PCTSUPP 
#> 0.4311525 0.3430075 0.2384789
coef(hc3)
#>    NARTIC    PCTGRT   PCTSUPP 
#> 0.4311525 0.3430075 0.2384789
```

### vcov

Return the sampling covariance matrix.


``` r
vcov(mvn)
#>                NARTIC        PCTGRT       PCTSUPP
#> NARTIC   0.0059415694 -0.0012776834 -0.0008687652
#> PCTGRT  -0.0012776834  0.0054366046 -0.0007155947
#> PCTSUPP -0.0008687652 -0.0007155947  0.0048641905
vcov(adf)
#>                NARTIC       PCTGRT       PCTSUPP
#> NARTIC   0.0049802810  0.000275673 -0.0003747817
#> PCTGRT   0.0002756730  0.004991986 -0.0006271090
#> PCTSUPP -0.0003747817 -0.000627109  0.0048455992
vcov(hc3)
#>                NARTIC        PCTGRT       PCTSUPP
#> NARTIC   0.0074482666  0.0008097275 -0.0001532905
#> PCTGRT   0.0008097275  0.0068517995 -0.0006062643
#> PCTSUPP -0.0001532905 -0.0006062643  0.0062822171
```

### confint

Return confidence intervals.


``` r
confint(mvn, level = 0.95)
#>             2.5 %    97.5 %
#> NARTIC  0.2719663 0.5729362
#> PCTGRT  0.1914314 0.4814446
#> PCTSUPP 0.1025579 0.3783487
confint(adf, level = 0.95)
#>              2.5 %    97.5 %
#> NARTIC  0.27048183 0.5471400
#> PCTGRT  0.19268371 0.4679947
#> PCTSUPP 0.09500669 0.3680568
confint(hc3, level = 0.95)
#>              2.5 %    97.5 %
#> NARTIC  0.22503755 0.5678080
#> PCTGRT  0.15977203 0.4868934
#> PCTSUPP 0.07622635 0.3879898
```
